blurb: Apple Pay is designed so a device, merchant, and payment network can complete a transaction without exposing a customer's card number to the merchant. The Secure Element stores payment credentials and creates payment-specific cryptograms, while Face ID, Touch ID, Optic ID, or a passcode authorises use when required. Device account numbers, tokenisation, and transaction-specific security values help limit the value of intercepted payment data. Tap to Pay on iPhone extends this model to contactless acceptance using the iPhone's built-in NFC capabilities.
